title: Hajj in Perspective
description: Hajj from the inside: the deep meanings, the returning pilgrim's new state, and the virtues behind the fifth pillar of Islam - beyond logistics and rulings. A mix of Newcastle Central Mosque and Garden of Ilm lectures, drawn from the Qur'an, Sunnah and understanding of the Salaf.

modules.title: The Soul of the Pilgrimage
modules.description: What Hajj is really about: sincerity, sacrifice and returning to Allah.

lessons.title: Answering the Call of Hajj
lessons.content: Why Allah called mankind to perform Hajj - the call of Ibrahim (peace be upon him) and the response it demands. Newcastle Central Mosque.

lessons.title: The Book of Hajj | Lesson 1
lessons.content: The virtues of Hajj and the state of the pilgrim who returns purified like the day he was born. Manhaj As-Salikeen. Garden of Ilm.

lessons.title: The Book of Hajj | Lesson 2
lessons.content: Who must perform Hajj, and what it means to answer Allah's call. Garden of Ilm.

lessons.title: P1 — Description of the Complete Hajj
lessons.content: The journey of Hajj as lived by the Prophet (peace be upon him): sincerity, sacrifice and worship at each station. Garden of Ilm.

lessons.title: P2 — Description of the Complete Hajj
lessons.content: The peak of the pilgrimage at Arafah: the day on which Allah sets free more of His servants than on any other day. Garden of Ilm.

lessons.title: The Book of Hajj | Lesson 7
lessons.content: Completing the pilgrimage - what it means to return home as one reborn. Garden of Ilm.
